limits: Receipt/schema/count/execution checks, not automated quotation truth, historical authenticity or cultural permission.

F separation and reconciliation checks are structural: they verify that the evidence keeps passage support, whole-claim support and raw worker labels in distinct fields; they do not adjudicate the labels' correctness.

Negative-control scripts are executed read-only with a 120s timeout; their recorded stdout digest is taken after normalizing temporary paths and timestamps, so the receipt is reproducible across runs, and a control that wrote to the repository would be visible in git status but is not otherwise sandboxed.
The replay leg accepts only a manifest with zero mismatch and zero could-not-evaluate rows; historical manifests (round-3/round-4) are not accepted as D evidence.
All reviews are author-side; this runner decides no admission, promotion or closure, and never certifies canon.
